summary: Re-review after the light-touch declutter (logs/clutter_audit_2026-11-21_a.json, level_09 entry). The chat is now 15 lines, and the three-line trip_fund stack is a single line. Fairness holds: the merged line keeps the $ budget implied (trip fund plus 'more than a few bucks', no price tier named), so the River Bell trap is still fair. River Bell's card shows $$ and its review says 'the bill was a step up from our usual intern lunch'. The line also keeps 'and then i cry', which Maya's River Bell partial line ('the trip fund is crying, and so am i') echoes. Losing 'the coast trip is coming up fast' costs nothing, because the trip fund is a long-running callback. The flow reads naturally: 'also, gentle reminder' follows Brooke's peanut check, Liam's 'cheap thai is the best thai anyway' answers Maya directly, and Brooke's 'count me in!' now agrees with cheap thai before she adds her climbing need. Voice is intact, with Maya's dramatic trip-fund worry and Brooke as the cheerful organizer. The Cyrus story beat (script[6]-[9]) and Brooke's 'i'll still double check' (script[10]), which her Monsoon Alley fail line points to, are untouched. Every outcome line that refers to the chat still has its setup. Since the last review, Monsoon Alley has gained its neutral detail (the love-song playlist). Orchid Row still has 'dipping sauces on the side', the minor overlap with Brooke's 'no dipping sauce' that the last review flagged as a suggestion. Gabriella has since edited that file and kept the wording, so it is not raised again here. No must-fix and no new suggestions.
